In 5-dimensional [[geometry]], there are 19 [[uniform 5-polytope|uniform polytopes]] with A<sub>5</sub> symmetry. There is one self-dual regular form, the [[5-simplex]] with 6 vertices.

Each can be visualized as symmetric [[orthographic projection]]s in the [[Coxeter plane]]s of the A<sub>5</sub> Coxeter group and other subgroups.

== Graphs ==
Symmetric [[orthographic projection]]s of these 19 polytopes can be made in the A<sub>5</sub>, A<sub>4</sub>, A<sub>3</sub>, A<sub>2</sub> [[Coxeter plane]]s. A<sub>k</sub> graphs have ''[k+1]'' symmetry. For even k and symmetrically nodea_1ed-diagrams, symmetry doubles to ''[2(k+1)]''.

These 19 polytopes are each shown in these 4 symmetry planes, with vertices and edges drawn and vertices colored by the number of overlapping vertices in each projective position.
